title: HomeFlood Claims Manual — Reporting, Adjustment and Proof of Loss
content:
**Covered losses.** Under HomeFlood Private Residential Flood Policies, a claim is taken for direct physical loss by flood to insured property at the insured address.

**Coverage period.** A claim is covered only when the date of loss falls on or after the date the coverage took effect, and before the cancellation effective date or the term end. A loss within a lapse between an expiration and a reinstatement is not covered. The customer reports the date of loss; the effective date, term end and any cancellation effective date are read from the policy record.

**Adjustment.** The adjuster contacts the insured within the tier's adjuster contact standard, in elapsed hours, of the report. Every adjuster report measures:
- the dwelling loss at replacement cost and at actual cash value;
- the other structures loss;
- the personal property loss at replacement cost and at actual cash value;
- the part of the loss in a finished basement;
- the pool loss;
- the loss of use incurred.

A final report supersedes earlier ones. A later supplemental report supersedes the final report for what it measures.

**Proof of loss.** A proof of loss is accepted only when it is received no later than the tier's proof-of-loss period, in calendar days, after the date of loss. The period is counted by adding the days to the date of loss on the calendar, and the last day qualifies. The date of loss is the one recorded on the claim.

**Payment and appraisal.** Tidemark pays within the tier's payment period, in calendar days, after agreeing the proof of loss. When the insured and Tidemark disagree on the amount of loss and the tier makes appraisal available, either may demand appraisal.

## Proof of loss: boundary cases (60-day period, abstract dates)

| Proof of loss received | Accepted? |
|---|---|
| on the day that is the date of loss plus 60 calendar days | yes; the last day qualifies |
| one day later | no |

*Hypothetical illustration:* a flood on 1 August gives a last qualifying day of 30 September.
